epic.name: Light and Dark Themes
unverifiedAssumptions: With JavaScript disabled the app renders in LIGHT, because the pre-paint script is the only thing that can know the right theme and the server renders no theme class at all. Reasonable now that light is a first-class theme, but it is an interpretation of "dark remains the default look" — worth a nod.

A theme chosen in one tab does not update another already-open tab until it reloads; the choice is read once per document load. No acceptance criterion covers cross-tab behaviour, so it was left out rather than guessed at.
